### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Keep the central bank company alive.
###
### ORDER MATTERS AND IT COST A ROUND TO FIND OUT. The slot has to be granted
### BEFORE add_company, not after. Finland owns a central bank and no company
### slots at all in 1836 -- add_company simply had nowhere to put the company,
### and the +1 arrived a line too late to help. Same on the game-start pass.
###
### This is the safety net, not the main road. The company that owns a central
### bank is chosen when the bank is built -- zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank -- and
### this pass only catches countries that ended up with a central bank and no
### bank company at all, from a spawn path that was not rewritten.
###
### There is deliberately no remove_company here any more. Withdrawing
### company_BasicBank in favour of a flavoured company would strip the central
### bank of its owner, and nothing in the game can hand those levels to the
### replacement: add_ownership only exists inside create_building. The flavoured
### company now wins by being picked first, at creation, instead of afterwards.

zz_ef_cm_bank_company_upkeep = {
	### 1. The slot first.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter }
		}
		add_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		}
		remove_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}

	### 2. Then the company.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_bank_company = yes }
		}
		add_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
	}

	### 3. And the monopoly on central banks goes to whoever holds it.
	if = {
		limit = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		zz_ef_cm_bank_monopoly = yes
	}
}
